queries.query: By how much did the variety of subjects in a typical person's reading shrink over the three months?
queries.target_quote: After twelve weeks the median user saw articles from 4.1 sections a week, down from 6.3 at the start.

queries.query: What share of links in the network bridged separate groups of readers?
queries.target_quote: Only 3 percent of connections in the co-reading graph joined users from different clusters.

queries.query: 有没有什么简单办法能让推荐重新变得多样一些？
queries.target_quote: In a follow-up arm, adding one randomly chosen story from an unfamiliar section to every tenth slot restored most of the lost diversity, at a cost of about 2 percent of clicks.
The ranking model was trained on clicks and dwell time, with no explicit term for diversity.
